557:t_123:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$! We'll stop your warped attempt to fix the world!」

557:t_124:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't look away from the past! Overcome it!」

557:t_124:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「You think I'll go along with that empty slogan?」

557:t_124:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'm not running from the past. I'm simply trying to overcome it.」

557:t_124:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't think you're the only person living with wounds!」

557:t_124:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I won't let a coward like you do whatever he wants with people's lives!」

557:t_125:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$ラプラスの箱$$, which that $$ガンダム$$ points to... Only despair awaits when you open it.」

557:t_125:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Do you know what $$ラプラスの箱$$ really is!?」

557:t_125:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「I had a fair amount of dealings with $$フル・フロンタル$$, you see.」

557:t_125:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「But something beyond even his expectations sleeps inside it...」

557:t_125:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「My final advice to you: if you survive, seal it away.」

557:t_125:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't listen to someone like you who runs from the present!」

557:t_125:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We don't fear the past or despair! We place our hope in the possibilities of the future!!」

557:t_126:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「Another person using the word 'future' irresponsibly, it seems.」

557:t_126:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「I won't hand the world so many people have shed blood to protect to a man who runs to the past...!」

557:t_126:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Then you ought to thank me for destroying the Empire.」

557:t_126:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「Our task isn't to defeat enemies! It's to restore peace to this world!」

557:t_126:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「I won't let your selfish logic destroy this world we must protect!」

557:t_127:0.en:
$$シン$$
「What you're trying to do is worse than war! It's a one-sided massacre!」

557:t_127:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「But my plan will end the war, though both sides will suffer losses.」

557:t_127:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll leave the rest to you. Do as you please with this world.」

557:t_127:4.en:
$$シン$$
「If you want to go to the past, go alone! But you've dragged others into it, so you're my enemy!!」

557:t_128:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「I know, $$キラ・ヤマト$$. You live with regret, too.」

557:t_128:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「But I'm alive. To overcome the sorrow and move beyond it.」

557:t_128:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're admirable. I can't be like that, so I'll do as I please.」

557:t_128:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「You can't be allowed to take lives for that.」

557:t_128:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「That's why I'll stop you! So no one else has to suffer my regret!」

557:t_129:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「What a shame, $$赤い彗星$$. I won't get to see you settle things with $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

557:t_129:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「So your indiscriminate global massacre was $$フル・フロンタル$$'s trump card.」

557:t_129:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「You should learn from his pragmatism. Without it, you cannot guide this world.」

557:t_129:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「Efficiency and rationality are ultimately empty intellectual theories. They cannot move the world... or people!」

557:t_129:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「Your selfish attempt to fix the world is the same! Don't think logic lets you do as you please with human lives!」

557:t_130:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Target confirmed. Attack target: $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$.」

557:t_130:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「Neither I nor $$ベリアル$$ are so cheap that you can shoot us down that easily.」

557:t_130:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But I'll strike you down by any means. For this world...!」

557:t_131:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「I never thought you'd side with the $$赤い彗星$$. A woman after all, I suppose.」

557:t_131:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You, who flee to the past, could never understand what it means to bet on the future.」

557:t_131:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Fine, $$ハマーン・カーン$$. But you'll learn that despair awaits you in the future, too.」

557:t_131:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「And you'll regret leaving $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

557:t_132:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「We've seen plenty of people spout selfish logic, but you're the first to remake the world for it!」

557:t_132:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「It was simply the only way to fulfill my wish.」

557:t_132:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's how deep the despair I suffered was.」

557:t_132:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「I can't measure your despair by my own standards...」

557:t_132:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「But if you're going to kill people all over the world for it, I'll stop you!」

557:t_133:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Before you start spouting logic, listen to my soooooong!!」

557:t_133:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「If I could have lived like you, perhaps I'd have been happy...」

557:t_133:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「But I chose this path. I won't let anyone get in my way.」

557:t_134:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Stop the plan at once! Do you understand what you're doing!?」

557:t_134:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「Of course. But there's nothing to mourn.」

557:t_134:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't use your logic to decide for living people! What sorrow is greater than having your life taken!?」

557:t_134:3.en:
$$レド$$
「If you won't stop, I'll do it by force! For the people living in this world!」

557:t_135:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「So you came after all.」

557:t_135:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Out of my way. I'm going to get $$千鳥$$.」

557:t_135:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「So you don't even care about me.」

557:t_135:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「What a coincidence. I feel the same.」

557:t_135:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「But if you get in my way, that's another matter.」

557:t_135:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's more like it...! This time, I'll kill you right in front of her!」

557:t_135:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm not wasting time on your idle chatter! Here I come!」

557:t_136:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$ルルーシュ・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$. If you'd supported my plan, things would have been far easier.」

557:t_136:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you know who I am, you should understand that's a pipe dream.」

557:t_136:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Thinking about it, it's absurd. The world's two greatest minds settling things by force like this.」

557:t_136:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll use any means to stop your warped plan...!」

557:t_136:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And I'll protect this world! For those who dreamed of its future!」

557:t_137:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「Causality is distorted in this space. Your power as an $$異能生存体$$ may not work, either.」

557:t_137:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even you seem afraid of dying now. In that case...」

557:t_137:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no intention of dying.」

557:t_137:4.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I'll live in this world. You stand in my way, so you're my enemy.」

557:t_138:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「I used your data as a reference for this $$時空修復$$, too.」

557:t_138:1.en:
$$桂$$
「If $$オルソン$$ and I are involved, let me cast a vote against this plan.」

557:t_138:2.en:
$$桂$$
「No one should carry out $$時空修復$$ on a selfish whim! As the original $$特異点$$, I'll say that much!」

557:t_138:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Those words won't stop me. I'm long past the stage of being bound by morality.」

557:t_138:4.en:
$$桂$$
「When you spout a classic villain line like that, it lets us use force, too! Brace yourself, genius!」

557:t_139:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「Another person living with regret, then.」

557:t_139:1.en:
$n
「Investigating someone like me... You seem to have had plenty of free time for someone with such a grand plan.」

557:t_139:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Not really. But $c... and you in particular... intrigued me in various ways.」
